title: POV: you’re on the @& Juliet on Broadway bus with joey fatone singing...
transcript: when's the best month to buy Broadway tickets? uh it's gonna be may yeah that's when you should get them my inner 90s kid is thriving because yes that is Joey Fatone of NSYNC fame and now in &Juliet on Broadway and I got to ride on the &Juliet double decker bus with the cast as Joey is playing tour guide he's cracking jokes pointing out random stops hyping up pedestrians you can watch the full video on &Juliet’s instagram but this was the moment we were waiting for because &Juliet has a new billboard right in the middle of Times Square and Maya Boyd is on it everyone just lost it the cast was cheering I was cheering Joey is hyping her up to everyone on the ground I actually couldn't believe it was there because it was a very special moment I am kind of obsessed with the current cast of &Juliet cause obviously you have Maya and Joey but you also have Alison Luff and Drew Gehling and Liam Pearce and Michael Ivan Carrier and obviously Charli D'amelio it's icons only and we finished the ride with an NSYNC sing-along and for like a minute it felt like I was actually in &Juliet which we all agreed would be the most fun show on Broadway to be in if you want to see Joey Fatone in &Juliet you have until July 31st but &Juliet is definitively the best party on Broadway so don't miss it
